GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down last 9 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 12 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground in straight. (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME) # slow out/no threat

Jumped awkwardly then Restrained & Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide at 350m and Four Wide Straightening Up , Made Some Ground in Straight # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted in. Shortly after the start was restrained to find cover. Laid in under pressure from the 400m. Near the 350m, eased when close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Ridden Along back 3rd last Two Wide 10 Lengths 700m, came Wide soon after Straightening Up , bit green in Straight and although made some ground was never close, Tongue Tie off again # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the early stages of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn then taken around heels Straightening Up and kept trying in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , took sit behind Clear Leader 2 Lengths 700m, off fence to chase Leader Straightening Up , tried hard last 200m and held close minor placing # held placing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out round turn near the 900m shifting out despite the efforts of its rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , Ridden Along back 2nd last rails 12 Lengths 800m, Ridden Along from the 400m, passed a couple but she was never close # Disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover from the 600m. Rdr reported mount laid in for the majority and proved difficult to ride out to the line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Niggled early & raced Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & out 3 Wide @ 450m & pushed to quicken & bumped Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Unbalanced @ 250m & pressured @ 200m. Making ground when ran out of room late. # Unlucky!

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 4 Lengths rail turning, Held Up home turn then taken around heels Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Laid in under pressure down the running proving somewhat difficult to ride out.] # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Laid in under pressure down the running proving somewhat difficult to ride out.

Bumped soon after the start. Raced at the rear of the field for some distance before improving into the race from the 600m where it raced wide with cover. Laid in for some distance while racing in the home straight before being corrected by the rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then Restrained and Settled Down last 11 Lengths from the lead, railed up to 8.5 Lengths turning, kept improving close to rail in straight. (Tongue Clip OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie AGAIN) # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid in over the final 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Five Wide trailing a neck, Drifted Back to trail 0.75 Lengths Four Wide turning, lost a couple of lengths in straight. (Blinkers FIRST TIME, Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) # never on track
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide for the majority. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length on fence, held together much same to turn then Hooked Out to 1 length 3 Wide , angled wider Straightening Up then Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re settling more forward than expected. Jockey advised that obtaining a forward position had been consistent with instructions previously, however it had been unable to do So on those occasions over shorter distances.] # weakening 3rd place
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out near the 1100m when momentarily crowded, raced wide from then on. Laid in rounding the home turn & under pressure in the home straight.
